primary_claim: Black-box monitors for scheming in LLM agents, trained purely on synthetic data generated via a Constitutional-Classifiers-style pipeline, transfer their detection signal to more realistic grounded sandbox trajectories (ControlArena), and a simple 15-candidate prompt selection matches extensive human refinement and automated prompt optimization, which quickly overfit instead.
quote: Monitors optimized purely on synthetic data pick up a real scheming signal on ControlArena.
